title: Design Token Mapper admin contract
purpose: Promote frame 04 into a bounded future admin token-mapping dossier.
scope_boundary: Admin-only token source, token group, selector binding, state mapping, preview stylesheet, and report UI; no frontend CSS export or design-system builder runtime.
entry_condition: TASK-009 snapshot/export is complete and design-token scope remains explicitly deferred from the Filter Preset first slice.
exit_condition: Design Token Mapper tasks and visual tests are defined with CSS export/runtime deferred.
allowed_expansion: Define token source and token group admin models.
Define selector binding and state mapping tables.
Define preview/report states and visual QA requirements.

budgets.context_budget: frame 04 plus token mapper source notes

Define visual QA for token tables, pipeline, inspector, and contrast/focus ring report states.
